purpose: Explicit causal annotation delivery and qualified-consumer diagnostic replay; no financial run.

inputs.deliveries: immutable AnnotationDelivery tuples with declared observed_at and content-bound witness bytes
inputs.requests: immutable explicit EqualPairRequest/SfpContextRequest tuples, each with requested_at and already-closed window

causality.clock: journal observes every actual closed replay frame even without annotations
causality.delivery: first actual frame at/after declared arrival; cannot backfill earlier frame
causality.future_schedule: excluded from per-step batch until observed/requested; full input SHA is run metadata only
causality.context: complete bound receipts and typed consumer envelopes fingerprinted in batch
causality.failure: partial frame never emitted; session poisoned and requires fresh instance
causality.timezone_identity: Delivery/claim/request timestamps normalized to UTC before identity, sort and duplicate checks.

result_limits: EQH/EQL qualification is not trade context
SFP context is not full priority1 pattern qualification
Actual market annotation truth/blindness/arrival authenticity not established by declared schedule
artifact_mode: SYNTHETIC_QA_NOT_MARKET_HISTORY; real annotated diagnostic data may be supplied only with equally explicit provenance; no financial permission follows.
